headline: Tokenized Stocks in America (Vlad Tenev essay) — Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens absent from US market
notes: Tenev: global tokenization supercycle in early innings; Robinhood Chain (London 'The World Is Flat') fastest EVM chain to 100M transactions; Stock Tokens give 120+ countries economic exposure to 190+ US stocks backed 1:1 by underlying shares; NOT yet available in US. US debate = eager vs skeptical. Three US advantages claimed: real-time settlement (GameStop lesson), 24/7 trading, portability + self-custody. Exact essay URL NOT verified this session; verified references: robinhood.com/newsroom launch, docs.robinhood.com/chain/stock-tokens. Stock Tokens are tokenized debt securities issued by RHJ (Robinhood Assets Jersey) - economic exposure, not legal/beneficial ownership; not registered under US securities laws; Reg S / non-US-persons only. THESIS LINK: this is the Robinhood Chain leg relevant to the OPEN (Opendoor) Solana->equity thesis thread - OPEN not yet tokenized on the chain; Stock Tokens are the economic-exposure-only bridge, not direct share ownership.
